name: Civil & Infrastructure
shortSummary: Roads, buildings, earthworks, drainage and erosion control.
summary: Design and construction of roads, buildings and civil works, from earthworks to finished surfaces.
body: Civil engineering is where Sato began. We design and build the infrastructure that institutions and communities depend on, and we manage every stage, from site preparation to handover.
capabilities: Asphaltic concrete road construction and road rehabilitation
Earthworks: grading, laterite filling, sub-base compaction
Building construction: academic, administrative, laboratory, residential and office buildings
Renovation and conversion of existing buildings

image.alt: Completed asphalt carriageway with kerbed median

name: Water Resources
shortSummary: Earth dams, irrigation, water supply schemes, boreholes and river works.
summary: Dams, irrigation, water supply and river works for government and institutional clients.
body: Water infrastructure has been central to Sato's work for decades, with clients including the Ogun-Osun River Basin Development Authority, state water corporations and the Federal Ministry of Water Resources.
capabilities: Water supply scheme construction and rehabilitation, including pump houses
Borehole drilling, including solar-powered boreholes, with our own drilling rig

image.alt: Stacked ductile iron pipes for water distribution
